modules.title: IoT Security Orientation & Legal Lab Boundaries
modules.lab: Draw an attack-surface map for a fictional smart camera; label allowed vs forbidden targets.
modules.output: One-page architecture + written lab authorization boundaries

modules.title: IoT Threat Landscape & Real Attacker Models
modules.lab: Build a threat register for a sample smart-home ecosystem and prioritize five risks.
modules.output: Risk register: asset, threat, consequence, likelihood, control, residual risk

modules.title: IoT Security Architecture & Trust Boundaries
modules.lab: Annotate a three-tier example diagram with trust boundaries and controls.
modules.output: Annotated data-flow diagram and top-five design decisions

modules.title: Safe Lab Build: IoTGoat, VMs & Evidence
modules.lab: Install or inspect the downloadable IoTGoat lab in a network with no public exposure; record snapshots and versions.
modules.output: Lab inventory, network topology, snapshots and safety checklist

modules.title: Embedded Linux Security Essentials
modules.lab: On an owned training image inspect /etc, services and startup scripts; propose least-privilege changes.
modules.output: Configuration hardening worksheet + redacted evidence

modules.title: IoT Network Enumeration – Defensive Asset Inventory
modules.lab: Use a provided pcap/isolated lab to list device IPs and exposed services; do not scan external devices.
modules.output: Asset inventory with owner, expected service and evidence

modules.title: IoT Protocols & Packet Analysis
modules.lab: Analyze a benign sample capture to classify protocol flows and make a normal-vs-suspicious table.
modules.output: Annotated packet evidence + baseline table

modules.title: MQTT Security: Authentication, ACLs & TLS
modules.lab: Run Mosquitto only on localhost/isolated VM and contrast a deliberately permissive config with an authenticated ACL-based config.
modules.output: Redacted config diff, broker logs, mitigation report

modules.title: CoAP, HTTP & IoT API Security
modules.lab: Evaluate a mock device API specification for missing authorization, exposed configuration and data privacy controls.
modules.output: API risk matrix + safe test plan

modules.title: Wireless IoT Threat Models: Wi-Fi, BLE & Zigbee
modules.lab: Review mock wireless provisioning flows and identify trust gaps without transmitting or intercepting traffic.
modules.output: Wireless threat model and mitigation matrix

modules.title: BLE & Smart-Home Device Security
modules.lab: Use the BLE CTF repository in a dedicated lab or analyze a supplied case study; document risks, not nearby devices.
modules.output: BLE service-access policy + annotated findings

modules.title: Zigbee, LoRaWAN & Low-Power Networks
modules.lab: Evaluate a fictional Zigbee/LoRaWAN deployment for provisioning and key-rotation risks.
modules.output: Network-key management plan and design review

modules.title: Physical Hardware Security & Lab Safety
modules.lab: Inspect annotated board images and classify potential exposure points without powering unknown hardware.
modules.output: Hardware inspection worksheet + safety assessment

modules.title: UART, SPI, I2C & JTAG Security Concepts
modules.lab: Using an isolated development board or supplied trace, identify debug-interface risks; never bypass locked devices.
modules.output: Debug-access threat model + recommended hardening checklist

modules.title: Firmware Image Formats & Safe Acquisition
modules.lab: Download official or intentionally vulnerable firmware; hash it and inspect file type without executing it.
modules.output: Acquisition manifest, SHA-256 and evidence log

modules.title: Firmware Extraction with Binwalk & SquashFS
modules.lab: Perform static extraction of IoTGoat firmware or another authorized specimen in a disposable VM.
modules.output: Extracted file tree summary and three verified observations

modules.title: Secrets, Credentials & Insecure Defaults
modules.lab: Audit a controlled test filesystem for example credentials; do not test recovered secrets against any real service.
modules.output: Sanitized secret-exposure report and remediation priorities

modules.title: IoT Binary Analysis with Ghidra
modules.lab: Analyze a licensed training binary in Ghidra to locate a deliberately hardcoded sample key without targeting real devices.
modules.output: Screenshots, annotated function map and CWE mapping

modules.title: Firmware Emulation & Dynamic Observation
modules.lab: Plan or build an offline emulation lab using an intentionally vulnerable image; record startup limitations.
modules.output: Emulation topology, service inventory and gap analysis

modules.title: IoT Web Interfaces & Embedded API Assessment
modules.lab: Review IoTGoat training web functionality in a host-only environment; document one vulnerability class and its secure fix.
modules.output: Vulnerability report with safe reproducer and mitigation

modules.title: Secure Boot, Signing & OTA Update Security
modules.lab: Threat-model a fictional OTA pipeline and sketch signature verification, version enforcement and rollback handling.
modules.output: OTA trust-flow diagram + release checklist

modules.title: IoT Cryptography & Device Identity
modules.lab: Audit example configuration files for TLS validation, unique identifiers and secret lifecycle without exposing live credentials.
modules.output: Key-management policy and crypto-control checklist

modules.title: Cloud, Mobile Apps & Ecosystem Security
modules.lab: Review a mock cloud-device architecture with a companion app; mark authentication, privacy and logging improvements.
modules.output: Ecosystem architecture review + prioritized controls

modules.title: IoT Botnets, DDoS & Malware Case Studies
modules.lab: From a supplied synthetic pcap, identify botnet-like outbound spikes and write containment steps.
modules.output: IoT malware case study, IOC summary and response plan

modules.title: IoT Forensics & Chain of Custody
modules.lab: Document a mock seizure/acquisition of owned test firmware and verify checksums before analysis.
modules.output: Evidence acquisition form + artifact hashes

modules.title: IoT Timeline Reconstruction & Investigation
modules.lab: Reconstruct an incident timeline from three synthetic logs and a training pcap.
modules.output: UTC timeline with confidence notes and corroborating evidence

modules.title: SOC Monitoring & Threat Detection for IoT
modules.lab: Create a local rule for unusually frequent failed MQTT connections or atypical outbound destinations in test logs.
modules.output: Detection description, test cases, false-positive notes and alert examples

modules.title: Industrial IoT / ICS Security & Safety
modules.lab: Map an illustrative industrial sensor deployment and propose read-only monitoring controls; no active testing on live plants.
modules.output: IIoT zones/conduits diagram and safety-oriented security memo

modules.title: Secure IoT Product Lifecycle, SBOM & Standards
modules.lab: Build a manufacturer security checklist covering procurement, shipping, patching, reporting and retirement.
modules.output: Device security profile with traceable control evidence

modules.title: Final Capstone: Full IoT Assessment & SOC Handoff
modules.lab: Assess only an offline IoTGoat image or your dedicated lab: trace three findings end-to-end from evidence to mitigation and SOC detection.
modules.output: Portfolio-ready package: architecture, evidence, finding reports, detection, executive summary
